TYPE 1 ZONING AMENDMENT PROJECT
NARRATIVE AND PLANS
900-10 W. Fulton Market Street

The Applicant seeks to rezone 900-910 W. Fulton Market Street from a Business Planned
Development Number 1475 (“PD 1475”) to a DX-5 Downtown Mixed-Use District for the
proposed rehabilitation of the four-story building at 900 W. Fulton Market, a new five-story
building at 906 W. Fulton Market, and the rehabilitation of the 2-story building at 910 W. Fulton
Market as a single integrated building. The building will contain about 29,665 square feet of
commercial space and nine dwelling units. The building's height will be 69 feet.

Pursuant to Section 17-13-0303-D, the Applicant seeks a variation to reduce the required rear
setback to 0 feet under Section 17-13-1101-B and to reduce any loading space requirement to 0
under Section 17-13-1101-D, plus an administrative adjustment to reduce the required parking
from 5 parking spaces to 0. The Applicant also requests all zoning relief required under the
Chicago Zoning Ordinance necessary for the plans subject to this Zoning Map Amendment.
